_about: Alice's bedroom, derived from the iPhone RoomPlan scan (room_scan/Project-2610301120.usdz). Units: meters. Y is up, floor at y=0. Room is recentered on its own center and rotated -2.49 deg about Y so all walls are axis-aligned. Yaw = degrees about +Y (three.js rotation.y): local +Z maps to world (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw). Each object's local +Z is its FRONT (the side facing into the room), local X is its width (w), local Z its depth (d). 'Footprint' below means the axis-aligned box of the rotated w x d rectangle. Values marked "estimated": true come from the photos, not the scan.
_orientation: Compass names are labels only. Standing in the entry doorway (south wall) looking toward the window (north, +Z): the closet and dresser (west, -X) are on your RIGHT, the bookshelf, glider and bed (east, +X) on your LEFT. This matches room_photo_4.jpg; no mirroring is needed in three.js.

new_items.comforter_drape: In bed-local terms: drape over the foot (local +Z) and the open long side (local +X, which is north at yaw -90); local -X is tucked. Better: tuck whichever long side is within 5 cm of a wall. Nothing may clip a wall; keep the drape thin (0.126 m to the bookshelf).

rug_options.label: Beige scalloped-edge rug with white dash borders

draw.method: procedural canvas with alpha (floor shows between scallops)
draw.edge: smooth sine-like waves (amplitude ≈ 1/4 of the wave pitch, pitch ≈ 9-10 cm on the real rug), continuing around ROUNDED corners
draw.binding: thin piped cord ~1 cm, #C9C2A6, following the wavy edge
bands_inward_from_edge: plain field margin, about one band wide
draw.bars: each bar spans the full band width and runs perpendicular to the band; thickness ≈ 1/8-1/10 of its length; ~50% duty (pitch ≈ 2 x thickness)
draw.corners: in the bands, bars turn into nested concentric L-shapes (mitered corners) instead of stopping

rug_options.label: Cream woodland-animal rug (unicorn medallion)
rug_options.fit_rule: For 5x7 use the full image. For 4x6 and 6x9 (2:3), crop rather than stretch: texture.repeat.x = 0.9333 with texture.offset.x = 0.0333 when texture.center is (0,0). If you set texture.center = (0.5,0.5) (e.g. to turn the image 180 degrees), use offset.x = 0: the repeat is then already centered.
rug_options.binding: draw a thin ~1.5 cm tan binding (#C9B48F) around the edge; the texture is cropped inside the printed field
rug_options.fidelity_note: The texture is a reconstruction: it is partly mirrored (2 owls, 2 raccoons, 2 hedgehogs, 2 peacocks), the deer is missing, and there's a seam near x≈800 px. It reads as the product at a glance but is not an exact copy.

rug_options.label: Current navy shag
rug_options.notes: Deep shag pile (procedural fibers or a noisy normal map); size and position estimated from room_photo_4.jpg. It starts at its real 4x6; the other sizes show what a bigger one would look like.

new_items.rug_orientation_rule: Rug size [a, b] in feet: a runs along world X, b along world Z (long side toward the window) at yaw 0. The TOP of every rug image faces north (the window), so it reads upright from the entry door. PlaneGeometry rotated -90 degrees about X maps image-top to -Z, so turn the mesh 180 degrees (mesh.rotation.z = Math.PI after the X rotation) or flip the UVs.

6x9.note: runs ~0.5 m under the bed - fine for a rug; stays clear of the floor register

8x10.note: 8x10 nearly fills the floor (2.44 x 3.05 m in a 3.29 x 3.44 m room): it runs under the bed, the dresser front and the glider

new_items.rug_size_change_rule: When the size changes, move the rug to that size's default center, unless the user has dragged it, in which case keep their center and clamp so the rug stays fully inside the room. Rugs may go under furniture but never through walls.
new_items.rug_delete_rule: One rug at a time. 'Delete' on the rug sets Rug = None and lists the rug in Removed; 'Restore' brings back the last selected rug type, size and position.
new_items.rug_state_rules: Presets and 'Reset layout' clear the dragged flag and put the rug at its size's default center (the shag at its fixed center). Changing the rug type or size with the Rug control keeps a dragged rug's center (clamped into the room); an undragged rug moves to the new default center. The shag can be dragged but not resized. 'As scanned' shows the navy shag at its center. The rug's Restore follows rug_delete_rule, not layouts.restore_rule.

_conventions.overlap: Overlap tests (restore hint, acceptance check) use the ROTATED w x d rectangles (separating-axis test). Axis-aligned footprint boxes are only for wall clamping and snapping. The glider/bookshelf boxes overlap but the real rectangles are ~2.2 cm apart; that is expected.
_conventions.rotation: Positive yaw (rotation.y) turns an item COUNTER-clockwise seen from above. 'Rotate clockwise' means yaw decreases.
_conventions.wall_items: Wall art and fixture positions: x (north/south walls) or z (east/west walls) and y are WORLD coordinates of the item CENTER; w x h is the outer size; the back sits on the wall's interior plane.
_conventions.camera_up: Never change camera.up; every view uses up = +Y. Top-down sits a hair south of straight-down so the window wall is at the top of the screen.
_conventions.portrait: fov_deg is vertical. When the viewport is portrait (aspect < 1), move the camera back along target->position by about 1/aspect (capped at 2x) so the room stays in frame.
_conventions.initial_state: First load shows preset A with layouts.planned. A preset's 'unchanged' bedding falls back to lavender_pompom when nothing is set.
